articles.title: Top & Bottom Bond Funds 2Q26: Bond Markets Rebound, but Rate Risks Remain
articles.claim_summary: Bond funds staged a broad rebound in 2Q26 as the first-quarter energy shock eased, though interest rate risks remain for the rest of the year.

findings.title: Treasury yields follow oil prices higher as Fed officials say rate hikes are needed - CNBC
findings.reason: The article confirms that interest rate risks remain for the bond market, reporting that Fed officials Beth Hammack and Neel Kashkari signaled the need for rate hikes in the autumn, which pushed the 10-year Treasury yield up to 4.71%.

articles.title: Fund Choice July 2026: Principal China New Energy Innovation Fund
articles.claim_summary: China's renewable/new energy sector is expected to perform well in 2026, favouring the Principal China New Energy Innovation Fund.

findings.title: China’s factories, construction slump in sign of deeper slowdown - The Edge Malaysia
findings.reason: China's official manufacturing PMI unexpectedly fell into contraction at 49.2 in July 2026, while economic growth slowed to 4.3% in the second quarter. This widespread slump in Chinese factory activity and broader industrial weakness undercuts expectations of strong performance in China's industrial and new energy manufacturing sectors.
